caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a hammer, positioned upright with its handle pointing downward and the head at the top. The handle is made of wood, with a textured grain pattern in varying shades of light brown and tan. The head of the hammer is metallic, extending horizontally across the top of the handle, and is colored in muted brown and gray tones with some visible signs of wear or patina. The head features two distinct ends: one end is flat and slightly wider, while the opposite end is elongated and curves downward, forming a claw. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and there are no additional objects or elements present in the composition.
